description: Strategies confirmed to hit the OOM killer (SIGKILL, no exception logged) both under the original 13-14GB / --workers 2 pooled-backtest setup and again after the 2026-09-07 increase to a 16GB VM with --workers 1 - a single process given the entire memory budget, no concurrent worker left to blame. A strategy listed here is excluded from regime/full_backtest.py's automatic retry so it does not keep re-attempting a run that has already failed under the most generous resource conditions this audit can offer. It stays admitted (E1_expanded); it permanently lacks a Stufe-9 pooled-performance figure, the same consequence as POOLED_BACKTEST_PERFORMANCE_LIMIT.json.

BBRSI2.why: resource_inconclusive under the original 13-14GB / --workers 2 setup, and still resource_inconclusive after the 2026-09-07 change to a 16GB VM with --workers 1 (one process, the full memory budget to itself, no concurrent worker to compete with) - 1 confirmed attempt(s) recorded in results/regime/full_backtest_manifest.json since attempt history tracking began, on top of the pre-tracking failures under the old settings that motivated the memory increase. Ruling out concurrency leaves the strategy's own memory footprint over 8 pairs and 6.5 years as the remaining explanation, not resource contention.
